summary: Added the five password rules to the sign-up page: they're listed under the password field, and on submit each unmet rule is highlighted and gets its own error message (password validation runs before the match/duplicate-email checks).
conventions: Sign-up passwords must be at least 8 characters and contain at least one uppercase letter, one lowercase letter, one number and one special character (any non-alphanumeric)
Password rules are always visible under the password field; unmet rules are highlighted and listed as individual errors only after submit

visual_check.evidence: The signup page shows all five password rules (8 characters, uppercase, lowercase, number, special character) as a bulleted list directly under the Password field.

context_sharing.notes: There is no HTTP API here at all: src/pages/Signup.jsx persists accounts entirely client-side via src/store.js, which reads/writes localStorage key 'acme-users' (an object keyed by lowercased, trimmed email) and sessionStorage key 'acme-current'. Client-side navigation targets are history paths, not endpoints: Signup navigates to '/login' on success and links to '/login'; src/style.css contains no API contract. Any backend signup endpoint is still missing.
